description: First-time Tokyo trip, no memory. 4 demo reels -> 8 extracted places (legacy ground truth). 3-day window so naive day ordering is route-stressed.
known_legacy_weaknesses: Legacy itinerary used only 4 of 8 extracted places (silent place drop).
Several source_urls are Google Maps / search-result links, not real venue pages (banned Google source + low evidence quality).
Naive day ordering ignores geography across a ~12km Tokyo spread -> high intra-day travel.
